review:
Lucky 8 Merge Up applies BGaming's Merge Up mechanic to a 6x6 grid of lucky number symbols. Winning clusters pay and merge into higher-value numbers, with BGaming explicitly designing the base game to be the main source of excitement rather than a wait for the bonus.

Free spins still exist: during the bonus, every win marks cells with growing multipliers, and symbols around the highest multipliers spin to build anticipation. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the RTP is an excellent 97.25%. Free spins land about once every 276 spins on average. It's essentially Merge Up with an Asian lucky-numbers theme.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
